slides.title: Weak vs. Great Prompts
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
The best prompts include 3 key ingredients.
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
So, what makes a prompt great?
slides.image_prompt: Two thought bubbles above a person's head: one with a confused AI robot, one with a smart AI robot giving a thumbs up

slides.title: The 3 Cs of Prompting
content: Clarity
Context
Constraints
slides.narration:
The best prompts almost always include three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
We call them the 3 Cs.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic: Three interlocking circles labeled Clarity, Context, Constraints

slides.title: Clarity: Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic answers.
Be specific in your requests.
slides.narration:
Let's start with Clarity.
This means being specific.
The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts give generic, unhelpful answers.
So, make your instructions super clear.
slides.image_prompt: Magnifying glass highlighting the word 'Specific' in a prompt bubble, with a confused AI robot looking at a vague prompt

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
slides.narration:
Here's a weak prompt example.
'Write about electric cars.'
What kind of electric cars?
For whom?
What specific aspect?
It's too vague.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of a chatbot with the prompt 'Write about electric cars.' The AI's response is a generic, short paragraph about EVs.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt
content: Good Prompt (Clear): "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Now, let's improve it with Clarity.
Look at this prompt.
Write a short blog post.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
It's for someone living in a city.
See how specific it is?
It's much better.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of a chatbot with the improved prompt for Clarity. The AI's response is more focused on city benefits.

slides.title: Context: Give it Background!
content: Tell the AI why you're asking.
Who is the audience?
Helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Next, let's move to Context.
Context tells the AI why you're asking.
Who is the audience for this information?
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
This makes the answer more relevant.
slides.image_prompt: Person giving background information (a small story or audience icon) to an AI robot, with thought bubbles showing audience and purpose

slides.title: Context: Starting Point
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's take our previous 'Good Prompt'.
It says, 'Write a short blog post.'
'Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.'
'It's for someone living in a city.'
It's clear.
But it still lacks some background.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the previous 'Good Prompt' for clarity, with a question mark floating above it for 'who is the audience?'

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt
content: Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Now, let's add some Context to it.
Here's the prompt.
'Write a short blog post.'
'It's for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living.'
'Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.'
'It's for someone living in a city.'
We've told the AI the audience.
It's for a sustainable living blog.
This gives the AI a perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the improved prompt with added context. AI's response is tailored to a sustainable living blog.

slides.title: Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style.
Guide the AI for specific results.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's look at Constraints.
These are boundaries for the AI's output.
Tell the AI the length you need.
Specify the format.
And also the style.
This guides the AI for specific results.
slides.image_prompt: A ruler, a clock, and a checklist next to an AI robot, symbolizing rules and boundaries for output

slides.title: Constraints: Current Prompt
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's use our 'Better Prompt'.
It says, 'Write a short blog post.'
'It's for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living.'
'Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.'
'It's for someone living in a city.'
It's good, but it could be even better.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Better Prompt' with context, with icons for word count, tone, and call to action floating around it, indicating missing elements

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt
content: Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
Here's an Excellent Prompt with Constraints.
It says, 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words.'
'It's for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living.'
'Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.'
'It's for someone living in a city.'
'Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone.'
'And end with a question to encourage comments.'
Now the AI knows the length, tone, and format.
It's a complete prompt!
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Excellent Prompt' with all 3 Cs applied. AI's response perfectly matches the constraints, showing word count, tone, and a question at the end.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick.
Helps the AI adopt a specific voice and role.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip.
Provide a Persona.
This is a super-powerful trick.
Tell the AI who to be.
It helps the AI adopt a specific voice.
And it takes on a specific role.
slides.image_prompt: AI robot wearing different hats (e.g., chef hat, doctor coat, travel agent uniform), representing various personas

slides.title: Persona: Example
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Look at this example.
'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel.'
'Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome.'
'It's for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
Here, the AI acts as a travel agent.
It's a very effective way to guide the AI.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of a chatbot with the persona prompt. The AI's response is a detailed travel itinerary from a 'travel agent' perspective, using appropriate language.

slides.title: Summary
content: Weak prompts give weak answers.
Use the 3 Cs: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
Clarity: Be specific and clear.
Context: Give background and audience.
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and style.
Bonus: Add a Persona for better output.
slides.narration:
In summary, weak prompts give weak answers.
Always use the 3 Cs.
Clarity means being specific.
Context gives background and audience.
Constraints set the rules for output.
And for even better results, add a Persona.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic summarizing the 3 Cs (Clarity, Context, Constraints) and Persona with keywords and small icons
